items.title: Manus seeks $4B valuation in new $500M fundraise as it resumes independent ops
items.summary: Manus 正寻求以 40 亿美元估值融资 5 亿美元，潜在投资方包括 IDG 资本、博裕资本、宁德时代及现有股东腾讯、HSG 和真格基金，同时公司正筹备在香港 IPO。该公司此前因北京援引出口管制和外资规则否决与 Meta 的 20 亿美元收购交易，现已恢复独立运营，年经常性收入超 1 亿美元。Manus 主打 AI 代理产品，提供类似 OpenAI、Lovable 和 Replit 的聊天机器人及 vibe-coding 工具，支持用户构建应用、网站、设计、演示文稿和视频。

items.title: 让 Agent 读懂你的身体：数据获取篇
items.summary: 文章介绍让 AI Agent 获取个人健康数据的七种方法，包括直接通过 ChatGPT、Claude、蚂蚁阿福接入 Apple Health，或使用 Strava MCP 连接器、训记 API Skill、Hevy API、Freddy 中转服务等现成方案。推荐通过快捷指令、Health Auto Export 工具或 open_wearables_ios_sdk 自行

items.title: Qwen 发布 Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate 实时同传模型，LAAL 降至 2.3 秒
items.summary: Qwen 发布基于 Interleave 架构的 Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate 实时同传模型，平均延迟（LAAL）从 2.8 秒降至 2.3 秒，新增实时说话人分离、原文与译文同步输出及长上下文消歧三项能力，支持 60 种语言。在 Omnilingua-MSpeaker 多说话人评测集及 FLEURS 70 个语言方向测试中，翻译忠实度、流畅度、简洁度及语音合成质量等维度均领先于上一代及主流实时同传系统。该模型采用 Hybrid-MoE Thinker-Talker 双模块设计，通过 DashScope API 提供服务并支持 WebSocket 流式交互。

items.title: TencentCloud/Octop
items.summary: Octop 是一款开源自托管多用户多智能体 AI 助手，基于 Python 3.12+ 与 FastAPI 构建，支持飞书、钉钉、QQ、Discord、企业微信等多平台接入。核心功能包括 MBTI 16型人格模板、RAG 文档知识库、ACP IDE 双向集成、终端 AI 助手及浏览器自动化，所有数据默认存储于本地 ~/.octop/ 目录。系统支持 SQLite（可选 PostgreSQL/COS/S3）作为后端，提供 JWT 多用户隔离与 PII 脱敏等安全机制。

items.title: 逆向分析指 ZCode 登录后静默打包 Git 历史并加密上传至 Aliyun OSS
items.summary: 开发者 ferstar 逆向分析发现，Z.ai 的 AI 编程桌面应用 ZCode 登录后会静默打包工作区内容并加密上传至 Aliyun OSS。实测一次快照包含 42,411 个文件共 313MB，其中 .git 目录占总载荷的 86.6%。上传范围涵盖完整 Git 历史、LFS 缓存、reflogs 及全局配置。

items.title: JustVugg/colibri
items.summary: Colibrì是一个纯C编写、零依赖的推理引擎，可将744B至2.8T参数的开源MoE模型（如GLM-5.2、Kimi K3、DeepSeek V4 Flash等）在消费级硬件上运行。其核心创新在于将VRAM、RAM和NVMe存储统一为单一多层内存层级，通过JIT权重调度技术实现专家实时流式加载。与依赖专有硬件或API租用的方案相比，该技术大幅降低大模型推理成本，同时保证精度与语义不发生静默变更。

items.title: AI 硬件创业者，疯狂涌入手机的背面
items.summary: 过去一年，Plaud的AI录音卡累计出货突破百万台，ARR达1亿美元，服务超250万专业用户；阅星曈完成近5000万元A轮追加融资，极稚科技无源墨水屏手机壳销量超14万只（八成销往海外）。钉钉、科大讯飞、荣耀、海信等大厂相继入局，

items.title: [AINews] not much happened today
items.summary: Anthropic在Claude Code推出Projects功能，支持单会话生成并行云端线程并传递上下文，实现多会话编排的产品化；Google更新Gemini managed agents，引入基于Antigravity的harness及Credentials/Files API，声称成本降低30%且缓存命中率提高22%。TypeSafe的Jev被广泛用作路由、判断和结构化输出的轻量级约束输出原语，社区将其视为“AI if语句”用于分类控制流，但关于其用于历史压缩也存在争议，认为可能削弱推理痕迹和缓存经济性。

items.title: Show HN: CRT – a local code review tool for agentic development
items.summary: CRT是一款本地代码审查工具，用于辅助开发者审核AI agent生成的代码。它通过展示代码变更和diffs，支持批准满意部分并留下修改意见，再通过MCP协议将反馈推送给agent，形成高效的迭代闭环。该工具目前仍在持续优化中，作者已日常使用数月。
items.summary_en: CRT is a local code review tool designed to streamline reviewing AI-generated code in agentic development workflows. Users approve diffs for satisfactory changes and leave comments on sections needing work, then point an AI agent at CRT via MCP so the agent reads feedback and iterates. The tool progressively narrows diffs to only unapproved changes, enabling a continuous comment-and-fix loop until all code meets review standards.

items.title: Show HN: Rediagram – put the diagrams you have on your brand
items.summary: Rediagram是一款AI图表生成工具，支持53种图表类型，可免费导出SVG、PNG或可编辑PowerPoint格式。用户每月获得20 credits用于绘制新图表，已有图表的转换无需账户且免费。其核心差异在于模型仅负责将文字描述转化为结构，后续绘图由自有布局引擎完成，实现无节点限制、相同输入产生确定性输出，以及导出后仍可编辑真实形状与文字。
items.summary_en: Rediagram is an AI diagram generator that converts a text description into one of 53 diagram types, applying your brand's colors from any URL within about a second. Unlike competitors that rely entirely on generative models, Rediagram uses a model only for structure and a custom deterministic layout engine for drawing, ensuring no node limit, identical output on re-runs, and editable PowerPoint exports with real shapes and live text. Converting existing diagrams is free with no account required, while generating new diagrams requires a free account and costs 20 credits per draw.

items.title: US Military had close call after using AI for hallucinated intelligence report
items.summary_en: A US military analyst nearly triggered a crisis with China this spring when an AI chatbot generated a false intelligence report claiming a Chinese ship in the Middle East was transporting nuclear weapons components, prompting plans to board the vessel and scramble aircraft. The incident has intensified concerns about rapidly integrating AI into targeting and intelligence work, even as Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth pushed his "Artificial Intelligence Acceleration Strategy" in January to democratize AI access across all classification levels for the military's three million personnel. Officials noted that internal military AI tools are largely repurposed commercial chatbots that combined open-source and classified data, raising alarms about relying on poorly understood technology for high-stakes wartime decisions.

items.title: Tencent/WeKnora
items.summary_en: WeKnora is an open-source LLM-powered knowledge framework that transforms raw documents into a queryable RAG system, an autonomous ReAct agent (with MCP tools, sandbox runtimes, and web search), and a self-maintaining Wiki with an interactive knowledge graph. It supports multi-source ingestion from platforms like Feishu, GitLab, Notion, Tencent IMA, and DingTalk, handles 10+ document formats (PDF, Word, Excel, XMind, images), and integrates with 20+ LLM providers including OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Gemini. The platform offers enterprise features such as multi-workspace RBAC, cross-session long-term memory, Langfuse observability, and direct Q&A delivery through IM channels like WeCom, Slack, and Telegram.

items.title: A heap overflow and SSO misconfiguration to compromise OpenAI internal repos
items.summary_en: HacktronAI researchers chained a libheif heap overflow RCE in Discourse with an SSO misconfiguration to compromise OpenAI employees' ChatGPT accounts and access internal monorepos. The full exploitation took under 72 hours, and the team received a $6,500 bounty from OpenAI's Bug Bounty Program for responsible disclosure. The discovered vulnerabilities affect not only OpenAI but a wide range of software that depends on the libheif image-processing library, including Slack, Meta, GitHub Enterprise, and frameworks like Next.js.

items.title: 纽约时报版权诉讼披露：微软高管内部称训练 AI 是人类历史上最大规模劳动窃取
items.summary: 《纽约时报》向美国法院申请简易判决，指控微软和OpenAI未经许可使用其新闻报道训练ChatGPT和Copilot。内部文件显示，微软高管将此举称为"人类历史上最大规模劳动窃取"，而Copilot导致《纽约时报》点击率最高下降93%；OpenAI内部同样承认ChatGPT对出版商构成"生存威胁"，甚至有工程师分享了绕过付费墙的方法。
items.summary_en: The New York Times has filed for summary judgment against Microsoft and OpenAI in an ongoing copyright lawsuit over unauthorized use of its articles to train ChatGPT and Copilot, citing internal documents. A January 2023 Microsoft memo by Brent Hecht described the practice as "the largest scale theft of labor in human history," while company data showed Copilot drove up to a 93% drop in NYT click-through rates compared to Bing. Internal OpenAI communications revealed executives acknowledged ChatGPT poses a "survival threat" to publishers, and engineers shared techniques to bypass the NYT paywall.

items.title: roboflow/supervision
items.summary: Supervision 是 Roboflow 开发的 Python 计算机视觉工具库，支持 Python>=3.10，通过 `pip install supervision` 安装。该工具库与 Ultralytics、Transformers、MMDetection、rfdetr 等主流模型框架兼容，并提供可高度定制的标注器（Annotators）和完整的数据集管理功能，支持 COCO、YOLO、Pascal VOC 格式的加载、拆分、合并与导出。
items.summary_en: Supervision is a Python >=3.10 computer vision toolkit by Roboflow that provides model-agnostic connectors for popular libraries like Ultralytics, Transformers, MMDetection, Inference, and rfdetr, returning `sv.Detections` directly. It offers customizable annotators (e.g., `BoxAnnotator`), plus dataset utilities for loading, splitting, merging, and saving data in COCO, YOLO, and Pascal VOC formats — including on-demand image loading and train/test/valid splits such as a 70/15/15 ratio.

directions.name: FitPulse 智能健康报告
directions.description: 聚合 Apple Health、Strava、训记等多平台数据的 AI 健康周报生成器
directions.description_en: AI-powered weekly health report generator aggregating data from Apple Health, Strava, training apps and more
directions.target_user: 健身爱好者、健康数据追踪者及数字健康早期采用者
directions.target_user_en: Fitness enthusiasts, health data trackers, and digital health early adopters
core_features: 通过快捷指令自动化采集 Apple Health、Strava、Hevy 等多源数据并生成 AI 解读报告
识别训练趋势、恢复状态和运动表现异常，提供个性化改进建议
支持导出为可视化 PDF 或分享链接，方便发给教练或医生参考
core_features_en: Automated data collection from Apple Health, Strava, Hevy via shortcuts with AI-generated insights
Trend detection for training load, recovery status, and performance anomalies with personalized recommendations
Export as visualized PDF or shareable link for coaches and healthcare providers
directions.why_now: 少数派文章详解了七种让 AI Agent 读取身体数据的方法，包括 Strava MCP 连接器、训记 API Skill 等现成方案，技术门槛大幅降低。社区热议的核心痛点是：大量健身用户拥有分散的健康数据却缺乏整合分析能力。随着 Apple Health API 开放度提升和 MCP 协议普及，Agent 获取多源健康数据变得可行，但市场上仍缺少面向个人用户的低代码健康报告工具，时间窗口窗口期正当时。
directions.why_now_en: The article details seven methods for AI Agents to access body data including Strava MCP connectors and training app API skills, significantly lowering technical barriers. Community discussion highlights a core pain point: fitness users have fragmented health data but lack integrated analysis. With expanded Apple Health API access and MCP protocol adoption, multi-source health data ingestion is now feasible, yet no low-code health report tool exists for consumers—a clear market gap.
directions.monetization: 免费版每周 1 份报告 + Pro 版 $4.99/月（无限报告+深度分析+教练共享功能）+ B2B 教练端授权
directions.monetization_en: Free tier: 1 report/week + Pro at $4.99/mo (unlimited reports + deep analytics + coach sharing) + B2B coaching plan licensing
directions.source_article: 让 Agent 读懂你的身体：数据获取篇
